definitions.gloss: practical skill; practical technique; hands-on test
definitions.explanation: Skills or techniques demonstrated through actual practice rather than theory. Also refers to a practical examination as opposed to a written one.

examples.japanese: {実技|じつぎ}{試験|しけん}がある。
{筆記|ひっき}と{実技|じつぎ}の{両方|りょうほう}に{合格|ごうかく}しなければならない。
examples.english: You must pass both the written and practical exams.

examples.japanese: {教員|きょういん}{免許|めんきょ}を{取|と}るために、{実技|じつぎ}の{授業|じゅぎょう}を{履修|りしゅう}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: To get a teaching license, you need to take practical skill courses.

notes:
USAGE:
{実技|じつぎ} contrasts with {筆記|ひっき} (written) or {学科|がっか} (academic subjects). It is commonly used in educational and certification contexts.

FORMS:
{実|じつ} (actual, real) + {技|ぎ} (skill, technique).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実技|じつぎ}{試験|しけん}: practical exam
- {実技|じつぎ}{科目|かもく}: practical subject
- {実技|じつぎ}{指導|しどう}: practical instruction
- {実技|じつぎ}テスト: practical test
